title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 22: King Josiah, the repair of Yahweh's house, the book of the law found by Hilkiah and Huldah's message.

questions.text: How old was Josiah when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: In the way of which ancestor did Josiah walk, not turning to the right hand or to the left?
questions.explanation: He did what was right in Yahweh's eyes and walked in all the way of David his father.

questions.text: Whom did King Josiah send to Yahweh's house in the eighteenth year of his reign?
questions.explanation: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan the scribe to Yahweh's house.

questions.text: What did Hilkiah the high priest say he had found in Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, "I have found the book of the law in Yahweh's house."

questions.text: What did the king do when he heard the words of the book of the law?
questions.explanation: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

questions.text: To whom did Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan and Asaiah go to inquire of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum, and talked with her.

questions.text: Where in Jerusalem did Huldah live?
questions.explanation: Huldah lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter.

questions.text: According to Huldah, why would Yahweh's wrath be kindled against this place?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods... my wrath shall be kindled against this place."

answers.text: They had not repaired the damage to the house
They had forsaken him and burned incense to other gods
They had made a covenant with Egypt
They had refused to pay tribute to Assyria

questions.text: Why did Yahweh say he had heard the king of Judah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had heard him because his heart was tender, he humbled himself, tore his clothes and wept before Yahweh.

answers.text: His heart was tender and he humbled himself
He had built a new altar

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise the king about his death?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place."

answers.text: He would be gathered to his grave in peace
He would live forever in Jerusalem
He would be carried away to Babylon
